title: Final Showdown at the Shareholders Meeting

lines.text: An armed hitman hired by the jailed Diane aims his silenced pistol directly at Harper in the hospital room.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Drop the gun or I swear to God you will never leave this building alive!
Cole lunges forward with terrifying billionaire fury, tackling the hitman before he can pull the trigger.
Inside the grand glass auditorium, thirty nervous board members whisper anxiously about Diane and Jake's federal arrests.
Diane Whitmore, 58, stands at the podium in a tailored white suit, desperately trying to salvage her ruined voting block.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: My arrest for poisoning Evelyn was a hostile corporate conspiracy orchestrated by my ungrateful stepson!
The massive glass double doors swing open with a loud bang, revealing Cole and a bruised Harper walking in together.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You poisoned Evelyn and tried to murder me because you were terrified of the truth in her will.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: You are a broke night-shift nurse from St. Brigid's Hospital who has no legal right to sit on this board!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: She is my wife, and as the CEO of Whitmore Shipping, I am activating Evelyn's posthumous inheritance clause right now.
Cole slaps the finalized legal documents onto the mahogany podium, proving Harper owns fifty-one percent of the empire.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: This cannot be happening, my son Jake and I built this company for our family!
Suddenly, Harper gasps in agony, clutching her pregnant abdomen as federal marshals drag a handcuffed Diane out of the room.
